resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org and firelookout.com give gone by 1963; Oregon Lookouts gives disposal by burning in 1968. The story reports both. No source settles which is right.
Two sources date the cab to 1933; Oregon Lookouts also quotes 1931 and 1932 items describing an earlier lookout house and station on the site. The story says so and does not explain the gap.

sources.title: Substitute Point Lookout Site (US 993)
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Record says 'built' is not in the brief's events; the 1933 date comes from all three sources but Oregon Lookouts also shows a lookout house in 1931 and a station in 1932, which may mean an earlier building or a dating gap. Fate conflicts (1963 gone vs 1968 burned). Access not in any source, so omitted. The 1931 quote about the Aladdin-type house is a Six Twenty-Six item quoted on Oregon Lookouts, not checked against the original publication. Sources: 3 page reads (firetower.org, firelookout.com, Oregon Lookouts twice) and 1 web search.
